# PROMPT — Volume 07 Outline

**This is an outline phase and it is not a batch. It writes `outline/volume-07.md`, the first Volume 07 batch's chapter cards, and no prose. There is no Chapter 0301 to write and this phase does not write one. It writes no chapter, and at the end it creates exactly one next-phase prompt, which is the batch that writes Chapter 0301.**

**Do not edit `scripts/`, `.github/workflows/`, `.opencode/agent/`, `AGENTS.md`, `PHASE_SYSTEM.md`, `REPO_PLAN.md`, `OUTLINE_GUIDE.md`, `opencode.json`, or `state/phase-ledger.json`. Those are controller-owned. Only edit fiction, bible, outline, chapter, summary, continuity, character, open-thread and review files, and only the ones named below.**

---

## What this phase is for

**Volume 06 is fifty chapters on fifty days, days 251 to 300, one chapter to a day, and it is closed. `state/volume-06-close.md` is its inheritance and it is the one page this phase reads before it plans anything, and it was rewritten and re-verified by the Volume 06 close phase against the fifty chapters rather than against the batch records. Read it in full, then `outline/volume-06.md` in full, then `outline/series.md` in full, then the four decisions of record in `outline/series.md` under *DECISIONS OF RECORD*, then `bible/power-system.md` §§32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39 and 40.**

**This is the phase the repository has been waiting six volumes for, and the reason is worth saying plainly before anything else: it is the only kind of phase in this repository that is allowed to decide. A batch is told *do not decide what the volume is*, and *do not resolve anything listed as live*, and *do not invent a person established by narration*, and then told to write ten chapters, and the only chapters that can be written are chapters about a thing in a yard. Five batches of that produce a volume nobody can outline afterwards, because there is no central pressure in it to outline, and the volume of record says there is.**

**Volume 06 is the proof that the method works, and this phase should know exactly how, because the mechanism is short. The same finding is at `state/volume-06-close.md` §6 and at `outline/series.md` under *DECISIONS OF RECORD*, and it is not restated at length in any other state file; this prompt carries it once because it is the instruction and not because the record is thin.** `outline/volume-06.md` was written by the first outline phase that was permitted to decide, and all fifty of its chapters paid its plan: the central pressure is on a page, the midpoint is four sentences and a fifth in a room in daylight with a date on it, the climax is on a page, the resolution is on a page, and the new question is on a page. **The mechanism that made it work is not the outline. It is that the Volume 06 outline phase was given the authority to strike a plan line, to decide a voice, to amend a calendar and to choose a cast, and it took all four, in its own words, in `outline/series.md`, where a reader in a year can find them without a state file.** This phase has the same authority and this file uses it. **Take what you need to take, and write down what you took and what it cost, in `outline/series.md`, in your own words, and not only in this file.**

**And the honest cost of the last time, because an outline that only reports successes is not an outline. `outline/series.md` is now a document that describes a book one volume behind, and it will be one volume behind again by Chapter 0350 unless somebody amends it in its own words. Volume 06's climax also arrived as a different mechanism from the one its own line specified — Adrian did not close a northern threshold, because a volume in which nobody can be shown to be holding a column of days cannot produce a threshold being closed, and what it produced instead is a road that stopped being anybody's because nine households gave it back — and that is a better beat than the one that was planned and it is not the planned one, and the machinery that produced it was the outline's authority to depart, which is free, which is the point, and which this phase inherits.**

## 1. What this phase has to decide, and none of it may be left to a batch

**Four decisions, and a batch cannot take any of them, so if this phase does not take them Chapter 0301 will be written by somebody who has been told not to decide and the volume will drift for the fifth time.**

1. **THE VOICE, and whether Volume 06's is the one this book keeps for the rest of its run.** `outline/series.md`'s decision two already records it: fifty-day volumes, about a page and a yard and a wage in salt, nobody gets stronger, the antagonist is a form with no column in it, the only instrument that has not lied to anybody is a board nobody wrote on, and the narrator has no frame. **This phase should confirm that decision in its own words for Volume 07, or say in the same words that it is changing it and what changes with it. Silence is not a decision. Volume 05's silence is what cost this repository a volume.**
2. **THE VOLUME 07 LINE IN `outline/series.md`, reconciled against the fifty chapters that are actually on disk.** The line is at `outline/series.md`'s *Volume 07: The Glass Steppe (Chapters 301–350)* and the audit of its nouns is at `state/volume-06-close.md` §6. **Read that audit before deciding anything.** The short version: the line is made mostly of words this manuscript has never used and is not made of things it has never seen, which is the opposite of the Volume 05 line and much closer to payable; *scar*, *First Landing*, *Anchorstone*, *Quiet Choir*, *centuries*, *Veyran* and *Ivenn* are already on a page; and **four of its nouns collide with Volume 06's own vocabulary — *unwritten* stands nine times in Volume 06 and every one of the nine is the store's board, which nobody has written on since day 225; *class* stands three times and every one of the three is the volume's own prohibition; *version* stands three times and all three are the ordinary English word.** A Volume 07 outline that uses those four words has to decide what it means by them against a page that already means something else, deliberately, and the decision goes in the outline. **The decision may be to strike the line and write what the volume is, the way Volume 06's outline struck and replaced the Volume 05 line. **That is the decision this phase is allowed to take, and it is the same act as decision one of the last record — which was to strike the Volume 05 line and replace it with what Volume 05 was — and it is not the same act as decision one of *DECISIONS OF RECORD*, which was the reconciliation of the Volume 05 line and is already taken.****
3. **THE DAY MAP, and the calendar, and whether the days run 301 to 350 one to a day.** Day 300 is a Sunday by the founding rule and the forty-fifth day of the Short Month; the Short Month is sixty days and ends on day 315. **A weekday is a figure, day 1 is a Tuesday, and no chapter may take a weekday from a neighbouring chapter, from a day map, from an outline or from a state file.** `outline/volume-06.md` §14.2 gives three written reasons why a war volume does not get double days and they still stand. **If Volume 07 needs a double day it has to argue for it in its own outline against a rule that is now the default, and not quietly ignore it.**
4. **THE CAST, and the movement that puts whatever the plan needs onto a page properly.** `bible/power-system.md`'s own rule is that no name and no place arrives by narration, and it is checked for a room, in daylight, with a date on it, by a person. **Volume 06's state layer broke that rule and named a gatekeeper who is on no page, and the breaking was committed by the very instrument written to enforce it, and a reviewer caught it; `state/volume-06-close.md` §7.3 and §7.6 are the two findings this phase must not repeat.**

## 2. What Volume 06 answered, in nine lines, and the honest answer is short

**Gather this from `state/volume-06-close.md` §1 and check it against the chapters rather than copying it.** A correct page from nine hundred miles away asked for the days on every gate in a column of four and nothing happened for fifty days. A month was named on a page in a room by a notary who said the cost out loud first. A word was invented to enter a company and then nobody could be paid. A man refused a safe route and cost three villages a season and was right. Nine households gave their days back to themselves out of a door at the seventh hour of a Monday, and five of the nine had never been asked in time. A road north of the Marches shut and nobody shut it. A sentence arrived that costs one side everything and the other side nothing. A raft went to nine places on nine days and a household was heard at each and nobody signed it. **And a woman at a gate worked her gate for nine years, saw a straight line in the ground in an orchard, and told one man with a barrow and nobody else.**

**Nobody in fifty days got stronger. The gains are a case on a table, four places on a page, a word nobody can define, a month, a heading, a company entered by the name of a place and then not posted a wage, a refusal that cost a season, nine households that spoke first, a road shut for good, a sentence that costs one side everything and the other side nothing, a raft, a piece of chalk nobody is going to use, and a line in the ground nobody measured. None of them is a power. One of them is the price of a power. All of them are heavier than a power.**

---

## 3. What Volume 06 deliberately did not answer, and all of it, and it is not a gap

**The full list is at `state/volume-06-close.md` §2 and it is not to be shortened in the outline.** The first item is the one this volume is for: **WHAT WAS THE OLD CROWN TRYING TO KEEP IN ONE VERSION?** It is the first question this book has asked about motive and not about a road. Two rolls of the same gates exist — the Marches keep a gate, a keeper, a set of days and no column for a person in it, and the Crown has sent a roll of people — and nobody has ever put them side by side, and a keeper is not a holder, and eight names were moved between nineteen stones a hundred and forty years ago, and a straight line in the ground under about nine hundred paces of orchard is the evidence and nobody measured it. **Nobody in Volume 06 says what a single version is for and nobody may, and a Volume 07 chapter may stand somebody in front of the two rolls and may not put them together and say what the difference is worth.** That is this volume's answer to spend.

Then the rest of the list, and it is at `state/volume-06-close.md` §2 in full: the nineteen stones and the eight that are different; the keeper of the Redroot gate at a hundred and twenty-one days into a year of being angry, derived, on no page, in no mouth; the woman of forty-eight at Nine Elms; the girl of seventeen, who cannot be fetched; the delegation, which has not left; the room at the far end of the Narrow Mark; the boards under the chapel; the eight names at the foot of a hundred-and-forty-year-old page; the box; the line in the same book that is not a number; the six rooms and the page on the back of a stone and the two words in about nine rooms and the twenty-eight words on a slate; the two twenty-nine-year-old women; the consent fracture, paid by a withdrawal and not mended; and the fifth condition nobody gave. **Jonah Pike is on no page in the last forty-one chapters and presented as nothing, and his absence is not a departure and is not a resolution — and he IS on a page six times in Chapters 0253 and 0258, and `state/volume-06-close.md` §7.8 corrects the record that said he was at zero across the fifty.**

## 4. The eleven live items, and the standing prohibitions, and where they are

**`state/volume-06-close.md` §3 is the eleven live items, chosen because this volume's plan needs them, and it names the ones that were dropped and why. §4 is the standing prohibitions at full length. Neither is to be restated at less than its length anywhere.** Three of them are load-bearing in a way a batch will get wrong and this phase should carry into the cards:

- **The line in the ground is the inheritance, and the word for it is a decision this phase may take.** A straight line about a foot wide and about two inches deep, from the near end of a row of trees to a stone nobody put there, not a path and not a watercourse and not a furrow and not a boundary, about nine hundred paces off a shut gate on a road that comes down from the north side of the Marches. **Nobody has measured it, nobody has dug it, nobody has been told except a barrow of boards, and there is no word for it in this manuscript. THE WORD IS AVAILABLE AND IT IS OWNED: *scar* is on a page one hundred and thirteen times in Volumes 01 to 03 and is at zero in all fifty chapters of Volume 06, and this manuscript has defined it twice — *a scar is not a pattern, a scar is where a rule broke and went*, and *a scar in a person is a scar in a place with a hand in it*. Putting the word to the line is a room, in daylight, with a date on it, by a person, and it is this outline's to plan and no batch's to improvise.**
- **The four days of notice is the instrument and not a courtesy.** A notice on any day other than the fourth day before the room is a three-day instrument, and a three-day instrument does not fail, it arrives warm, **and a batch that has written one has produced a chapter with every figure in it correct and an instrument in it that does not exist.** Four batches in a row in Volume 06 paid for that and a check of numerals cannot see it.
- **An elapsed count is that chapter's own day number subtracted from the day the thing happened, and the day a thing happened has to be opened in a file and not remembered.** `bible/power-system.md` §33.6 is the anchor table for days 251 to 300 and this phase must extend it to 301 to 350 in the same numbered form, **and every value in it is derived and a derived value may be used in a chapter that dates it and may not be attributed to a chapter or to a mouth.** Twenty-one interval faults in one batch, seventeen in the next, and so on down to seven; this is the largest class of fault in the repository, it is born in outlines, and an outline that publishes a figure without publishing its anchor causes every batch downstream to check it.

## 5. What the next phase should know about the shape of the book, and the figures it will otherwise be told wrongly

**Read `state/volume-06-close.md` §5 and §7 before this phase writes a card. Six published figures moved when the volume was measured from outside, and every one of them is a figure a batch record prints and a later writer will quote.**

1. **The exchange shape, which is the finding left open against Volume 05 by `reviews/volume-05/batch-0004.md` finding 2 and `reviews/volume-05/batch-0005.md` finding 5, and which Volume 06 answered.** Across Volume 05, 597 of 629 plain speeches were answered in the next line by a bolded speech — ninety-five per cent — and the ratio rose as the volume went. **Across the fifty chapters of Volume 06 it is 316 of 798, thirty-nine point six per cent, and it rises as the volume goes rather than falling.** The last ten chapters' published figure of 59 of 104 is correct for its own ten and is not the volume's figure. **The definition is at `state/batch-summaries/volume-06-batch-0003.md` §8.1 and is used unchanged: a *plain speech* is a paragraph carrying a quotation and no bold mark, and it is *answered* when the very next non-blank paragraph carries a quotation and a bold mark.**
2. **And the cost, which belongs on the same page as the gain.** `outline/volume-06.md` §17.6's ceiling is four speech paragraphs and Volume 06 breaches it in six chapters — 0283, 0284, 0286, 0287, 0288 and 0290, at six to eight — all six in two batches whose own records certify the ceiling as held. **The two-hander broke and what came in its place in those six chapters is a longer two-hander. If Volume 07 wants a different shape, this is the outline that decides it, and it is a decision about the cards and not a style instruction to a writer.**
3. **The measurements a Volume 07 batch has to beat, on the definitions published, are at `state/volume-06-close.md` §7.5 and §7.9.** A bolded turn runs about thirty-five words; **the longest in all fifty chapters of Volume 06 is ninety-two words, in Chapter 0259, and two chapters carry one over the outline's eighty-word line.** The bolded share of words runs 6.2 to 21.9 per cent against Volume 01's 10.4 as the model and about 35 as the ceiling. Word counts on the definition the records actually used — heading line included, `---` counted, bold marks counted as nothing — run 133,363 for the fifty, mean 2,667, range 2,402 to 3,302. **The house band is 2,400 to 3,100 and Volume 06 has two chapters above it, 0251 at 3,135 and 0252 at 3,302, and neither is padded and both are complete scenes, so the band is a band and not a cliff.**

## 6. The checks, and the four that a close phase has now paid for

**Publish the definition or publish nothing, and run all seven, and running six is not running seven. That rule is `bible/power-system.md` §39.15 and §40.17 and it is the standing general rule of this manuscript.**

1. **Subtract, from the anchor, for every figure in the volume that has one.** The days the thirty-nine men under the near gate have gone unpaid, the days the board has stood unwritten, the days the wind has blown at that wall, the trestle count, the keeper's days into her year, the days the bag has been on the boards, the days since the settlement started, the age of the posting, the age of the share with the post taken out, the days the delegation has not gone, the age of the raft, and the age of every page and stone and rule the plan names. **The interval chain is the largest class of fault in this repository and it is one family.**
2. **Recompute the calendar from day 1 and grep for weekday words. Never from a neighbouring chapter and never from a state file.** **Three hundred and twenty-eight weekday tokens stand in Volume 06's fifty chapters and nine faults of one family were found in the last ten of them alone, all of them a recurring weekday standing next to an event nobody dated.** A weekday on a page outranks a weekday in a state file, and a day map is a plan and not a fact.
3. **The word-run check, run across the whole volume and not inside one batch's ten.** The forty-word-sentence definition is a good definition and it is blind to a duplication that straddles a divergence. **Run it across all fifty chapters, as `state/volume-06-close.md` §7.4 does: take each file as a flat list of words, take each other file as one joined string, find the longest run of consecutive words appearing in both, and subtract each file's own lead paragraph. In Volume 06 that finds a forty-five-word run between two chapters fourteen days apart and a forty-word near-verbatim sentence across a batch boundary, and four of the eight largest runs are the volume's motifs. A motif and a duplication are not currently separable by any instrument in this repository, and the volume outline has to say which is which before a batch inherits them.**
4. **The descriptor map, every *man or woman of about N* extracted and mapped to its trade, at sentence level and not at chapter level, and a check for co-presence.** **Three women of about thirty-four are on a page in Volume 06 and they are three and not four and not five; the man of about thirty-four who keeps a stall is a fifth person; and no paragraph in any of the fifty files carries him and a woman of about thirty-four together.** The map this phase inherits also carries **THREE collisions nobody had caught until the volume closed, and all three are on the page. First, and worst: Adrian Vale is given the age *a man of about thirty-two* in `chapter-0251.md:107`, `chapter-0286.md:59` AND `chapter-0289.md:51`, and the first of the three, on the volume's first page, hands him Volume 05's bank man verbatim — *a man of thirty-two on no roster of anything*, which is `chapter-0238.md:7` — and a man of about thirty-two is on a page sixteen times across nine chapters of Volume 05 as a different man entirely, so the prohibition that the two may never be in a room together is kept nowhere, because the page has put the two descriptions on one man. Second: there are two men of about thirty-eight in Volume 06, one at a wharf in this city in Chapter 0279 and one at a shut gate up a hill in Chapters 0295, 0296, 0299 and 0300. Third: Alys Kern is named on a page once, at `chapter-0257.md:129`, and three chapters carry an unnamed gatekeeper at the road west, which put a key on a string over a shoulder in the same kind of apron pocket as the brass key on a tarred cord at the shut gate in the north.** **A later writer who merges two of those has committed the exact fault the map exists to catch, and the map is at `state/volume-06-close.md` §7.6.**

## 7. What this phase delivers, and the one prohibition it has to earn

**Deliverables, in this order.** `outline/volume-07.md`, carrying the volume's central pressure, its starting state, its cast, its escalation steps, its midpoint, its climax, its resolution, its new question, the calendar and the day map for days 301 to 350 with every weekday derived from day 1, the extension of `bible/power-system.md` §33.6's anchor table to those days, the standing prohibitions carried at full length, the prose instructions, and the pressure rotation counted honestly with the first tag in each row and the rule stated. Then `outline/batches/volume-07-batch-0001.md`, the first ten to twenty chapter cards, each card naming whose speech is bolded, naming a third party or a task or a thing that has to be carried somewhere, and naming which of the three it is. Then, **in `outline/series.md`, whatever this phase decided — struck, amended, extended or left standing — in its own words and not only in this file.** Then the four state files repointed at this phase's successor, which is the batch that writes Chapter 0301, and exactly one next-phase prompt created at `workspace/volume-07/batch-0001/PROMPT.md`.

**And the prohibition this phase has to earn, and it is the reason the previous four volumes drifted: a batch is not an outline phase, a batch does not write a chapter, and a batch cannot decide what a volume is. This phase can, and every decision it takes must be written down in the place a reader in a year will find it, which is `outline/series.md` and not a state file. A decision that lives only in a state file has not been taken; it has been typed.**

**The next phase is `workspace/volume-07/batch-0001/PROMPT.md`, and it writes Chapter 0301. `state/current.md`, `state/continuity.md`, `state/open-threads.md` and `state/character-state.md` all name this phase now and must all name that one when this phase finishes, and a later phase reads `state/volume-06-close.md` first and then that block, and the two must not disagree.**
